role: The stairs block (oak, cobble, brick and the other ten ids): a half-height step plus a corner piece, collision boxes and metadata from the placed facing, with almost every other method delegated to the block it is cut from.

members.name: field_150149_b

members.note: The model's damage, folded into the per-id rows and icon table like field_150149_b.

notes: The delegation methods are marked n/a because the native engine dispatches per id and the model block's own handlers are Block defaults for every stair model in scope; if a stair of a model with real handlers (furnace? none in 1.7.10) is ever added, revisit. Stairs underfoot are exercised by walk300-s1 and fresh-play-s1 through collide.c. Pinned by lane/meshvar's mesh scene (out/java/rendertick/mv_variants, 13 views mv_variants_*, each within its budget with no pxdiff cluster; the scene's sections match the oracle's sections.bin vertex for vertex): every stair id at metas 0..7 isolated, and eight 3x3 rings (outward and inward, upright and upside down, the corners taking either side's facing) for the outer and inner corner shapes.
